basis: Foundation 41151189301 failed closed on freshly indexed advisories. advisories.summary: AbortSignal cancellation bypass permits traversal after cancellation
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: Pinned Frappe 988e54f3 executes socketio.js -> realtime/index.js, authenticate/utils and node_utils.js. Literal requires seed socket.io, @redis/client and cookie; the installed transitive production dependency graph contains 28 packages and neither glob nor minimatch. tools/native/security_acceptance.py now resolves and traverses that actual graph and fails if either package enters it. Product ingress product/web.cjs imports only node:http and node:child_process and launches fixed internal services. Remaining consumers are pinned asset build/lint tools (stylus, sucrase, rimraf, workbox-build, eslint/jake), operating on provider-owned source and patterns; no student/staff pattern input reaches them. This is availability-only build-tool reachability analysis, not a patched-version claim. Reassess if the runtime graph, ingress imports or build-input trust changes.
advisories.fix_path: Upstream patched major version 14.0.2; retain scoped build-only restriction and the actual runtime dependency-boundary check. Do not blanket-approve new advisories or new runtime consumers.
